skill.name: github-automation
skill.description: Automate GitHub issues, pull requests, branches, workflows, deployments, and permissions through the Rube MCP GitHub toolkit.
skill.summary: Manage common GitHub workflows through Rube MCP with repository-aware checks and approval guidance.
skill.author: sickn33

security_audit.summary: All 116 external-command alerts are false positives caused by Markdown inline code, not shell execution. The Rube endpoint is a real third-party network dependency that delegates GitHub access through OAuth. Workflow dispatch and access-control changes lack explicit confirmation requirements, although merge and deletion are guarded.

remediation.issue: Incomplete approval gates for privileged changes
remediation.suggestion: Require explicit confirmation before workflow dispatch, repository setting changes, branch protection updates, collaborator changes, and every destructive operation.

remediation.issue: Third-party OAuth and repository data access
remediation.suggestion: Document Rube data handling, requested GitHub scopes, token revocation, and least-privilege setup before users connect accounts.
Identify the official endpoint owner and advise users to verify the host before starting OAuth.

static_findings.snippet: - Active GitHub connection via `RUBE_MANAGE_CONNECTIONS` with toolkit `github`
- Always call `RUBE_SEARCH_TOOLS` first to get current tool schemas
**Get Rube MCP**: Add `https://rube.app/mcp` as an MCP server in your client configuration. No API k
1. Verify Rube MCP is available by confirming `RUBE_SEARCH_TOOLS` responds
- `GITHUB_LIST_REPOSITORY_ISSUES` returns both issues AND pull requests; check `pull_request` field
- Pagination: `per_page` max 100; iterate pages until empty
2. `GITHUB_GET_A_PULL_REQUEST` - Get detailed PR info including mergeable status [Required]
- `head`: Source branch with changes (must exist; for cross-repo: 'username:branch')
- `GITHUB_CREATE_A_PULL_REQUEST` fails with 422 if base/head are invalid, identical, or already merg
- `GITHUB_MERGE_A_PULL_REQUEST` can be rejected if PR is draft, closed, or branch protection applies
- Always verify mergeable status with `GITHUB_GET_A_PULL_REQUEST` immediately before merging
- `sha`: Commit SHA to point the new reference to
- `GITHUB_CREATE_A_REFERENCE` only creates NEW references; use `GITHUB_UPDATE_A_REFERENCE` for exist
- `ref` must start with 'refs/' and contain at least two slashes
- `GITHUB_LIST_BRANCHES` paginates via `page`/`per_page`; iterate until empty page
- `GITHUB_DELETE_A_REPOSITORY` is permanent and irreversible; requires admin privileges
4. `GITHUB_LIST_COMMITS` - List commits for a specific repo [Alternative]
- `GITHUB_SEARCH_COMMITS_BY_AUTHOR` requires keywords in addition to qualifiers; qualifier-only quer
2. `GITHUB_GET_A_WORKFLOW` - Get workflow details by ID or filename [Optional]
4. `GITHUB_LIST_CHECK_RUNS_FOR_A_REF` - Check CI status for a commit/branch [Required]
- `inputs`: JSON string of workflow inputs matching `on.workflow_dispatch.inputs`
- `GITHUB_CREATE_A_WORKFLOW_DISPATCH_EVENT` requires the workflow to have `workflow_dispatch` trigge
- Full path `.github/workflows/main.yml` is auto-stripped to just `main.yml`
- Inputs max 10 key-value pairs; must match workflow's `on.workflow_dispatch.inputs` definitions
- `GITHUB_GET_BRANCH_PROTECTION` returns 404 for unprotected branches; treat as no protection rules
- Determine push ability from `permissions.push` or `role_name`, not display labels
- Iterate until response returns fewer results than `per_page`
- Check CI status with `GITHUB_LIST_CHECK_RUNS_FOR_A_REF` before merging
- **Issues vs PRs**: `GITHUB_LIST_REPOSITORY_ISSUES` returns both; check `pull_request` field
- **Pagination limits**: `per_page` max 100; always iterate pages until empty
- **Branch creation**: `GITHUB_CREATE_A_REFERENCE` fails with 422 if reference already exists
**Get Rube MCP**: Add `https://rube.app/mcp` as an MCP server in your client configuration. No API k

content.user_title: Automate GitHub Workflows with Rube MCP
content.value_statement: GitHub maintenance requires many separate searches, checks, and updates. This skill coordinates repository workflows through Rube MCP with practical safeguards and validation guidance.
actual_capabilities: List and inspect repositories available to the authenticated GitHub user.
Create, list, search, and comment on GitHub issues.
Find, inspect, create, and merge pull requests.
Create repositories and branches, and update repository settings.
Search code and commits with GitHub query qualifiers.
Inspect or trigger workflows, check CI, review deployments, and inspect repository permissions.
limitations: Requires Rube MCP and an active GitHub OAuth connection.
Available actions depend on GitHub permissions granted through Rube.
Search and list operations inherit GitHub size, result, and pagination limits.
High-impact actions still require user approval and environment-specific validation.

use_cases.title: Maintain pull request queues
use_cases.description: Inspect changed files, mergeability, and CI status before preparing a merge decision.

use_cases.title: Organize issue backlogs
use_cases.description: Find, create, label, assign, and comment on repository issues with clear repository context.

use_cases.title: Review repository operations
use_cases.description: Inspect workflows, deployments, collaborators, permissions, and branch protection before proposing controlled changes.

prompt_templates.title: List open work
prompt_templates.prompt: List open issues in [owner/repo], separate pull requests, and summarize title, labels, assignee, and age. Do not modify anything.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare an issue
prompt_templates.prompt: Prepare an issue in [owner/repo] titled [title] with [body]. Show the proposal and ask before creating it.

prompt_templates.title: Assess a pull request
prompt_templates.prompt: Review pull request [number] in [owner/repo], inspect changed files and CI status, then recommend whether it is ready to merge.

prompt_templates.title: Audit access controls
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit [owner/repo] branch protection and collaborator permissions, propose changes, and require approval before every access or protection update.

output_examples.input: List open issues in acme/widgets and exclude pull requests.
output_examples.output: Found 12 open issues. Three are unlabeled, two have no assignee, and the oldest has been open for 46 days.
Pull request 42 is mergeable. One CI check is failing, so merging is not recommended.

output_examples.input: Audit protection for the main branch in acme/widgets.
output_examples.output: The main branch requires two approvals and passing checks. Administrator enforcement is disabled. No changes were applied.

best_practices: Call RUBE_SEARCH_TOOLS before workflows so each action uses the current tool schema.
Verify the repository, branch, identifiers, permissions, pagination, and current state before acting.
Require explicit approval before merges, workflow dispatches, repository updates, collaborator changes, or branch protection changes.
anti_patterns: Do not merge, delete, or alter access controls from an ambiguous request.
Do not treat one result page as a complete repository inventory.
Do not share OAuth links, repository content, or credentials with unrelated services.

faq.question: What connection does this skill require?
faq.answer: It requires the Rube MCP endpoint and an active GitHub OAuth connection for the GitHub toolkit.

faq.question: Can it modify repositories?
faq.answer: Yes. It documents issue, pull request, branch, repository setting, workflow, collaborator, and branch protection actions.

faq.question: Does it bypass GitHub permissions?
faq.answer: No. Every action remains subject to the permissions granted to the connected GitHub account.

faq.question: Can it access private repositories?
faq.answer: Only repositories exposed by the connected account and approved OAuth scopes are available.

faq.question: How does it handle large result sets?
faq.answer: It uses page-based pagination and must continue until a page contains fewer items than the requested page size.

faq.question: Does it merge pull requests automatically?
faq.answer: No. The skill requires mergeability and CI checks, followed by explicit user confirmation before merging.
